response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_patient

assumptions.assumption: Elevated UA means strictly greater than 3.9.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff includes UA values equal to 3.9.
